in_hebrew.name: Hiro
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hiro הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Japanese word 'hiroi', meaning 'shining' or 'radiant'. The name Hiro was traditionally given to babies born on a bright and sunny day.

in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Shining, radiant
in_greek.long_meaning: Hiro είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Japanese word 'hiroi', meaning 'shining' or 'radiant'. The name Hiro was traditionally given to babies born on a bright and sunny day.

in_latin.name: Hiro
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Shining, radiant
in_latin.long_meaning: Hiro est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Japanese word 'hiroi', meaning 'shining' or 'radiant'. The name Hiro was traditionally given to babies born on a bright and sunny day.
